name: Congo-Brazzaville Poulet Moambe
description: Poulet moambe, chicken stewed in real palm nut sauce, is widely considered the Republic of Congo's national dish, shared with neighboring DR Congo across the same cultural region - real palm nut cream isn't a distinct item here, so peanut butter stands in for a similarly rich, reddish sauce.
steps_detailed: Brown the chicken with the onion, 8-9 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter with the tomatoes and a little water, then add to the pot.
Simmer 25-28 minutes until the chicken is very tender.

name: Congo-Brazzaville Liboke
